testsuite.name: dev.proxyaudit.core.WebsiteDiagnosticsTest

testcase.name: full attempt deadline can recheck once within the unchanged total budget
plan defaults bare domain to https but rejects ambiguous or credentialed URLs
untrusted certificate fails TLS while preserving established connection
trusted but wrong hostname is rejected with no insecure fallback
HTTP send failure after verified TLS cannot erase the TLS success
absolute DNS deadline returns without starting replacement worker
trusted expired leaf is classified without bypassing certificate validation
trusted not yet valid leaf suggests clock or certificate investigation
advertised idle permits consecutive admissions without spurious busy rejection
body ceiling is partial evidence not website failure
redirect is not followed and exports only its origin when explicitly requested
slow response body respects absolute budget and preserves successful headers
HTTP forbidden is response evidence and never triggers automatic retry
close before execution never starts network work
local validated HTTPS GET records every layer without saving the body
system proxy selection is respected without silently connecting to target
same plan temporary failure is preserved when one automatic recheck responds
cancellation returns promptly but blocked DNS keeps the single work slot until actual exit
DNS failure does not blindly retry or expose exception text
